mapper.select: select * from board order by seq desc
mapper.insert: insert into board(writerid, title, content) values(#{writerid}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: select * from notice order by ispinned desc, seq desc
mapper.insert: insert into notice(writerid, title, content, ispinned) values(#{writerid}, #{title}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{ispinned}, false))
mapper.select: select * from qna order by seq desc
mapper.insert: insert into qna(writerid, title, content, issecret) values(#{writerid}, #{title}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{issecret}, false))
mapper.update: update qna set replycontent = #{replycontent}, replydate = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'COMPLETED' where seq=#{seq}
